title: 六级核心词汇
subtitle: ECDICT cet6 标签词表，去除四级及已收录词后按词频排序

defsEn: n. someone who is skilled at analyzing data
n. an expert who studies financial data (on credit or securities or sales or financial patterns etc.) and recommends appropriate business actions
n. a licensed practitioner of psychoanalysis
zh: n. 分析者, 精神分析学家
examples: The analyst collated the data and prepared a report.
Analysts sense a growing hostility between the two countries.

defsEn: n. standing or position on a scale
zh: n. 等级, 额定功率, 责骂
examples: What rating would you give this food?
The German Film and Media Review authority awarded the film the rating "particularly valuable."

defsEn: n. someone who finds financing for and supervises the making and presentation of a show (play or film or program or similar work)
n. something that produces
zh: n. 生产者, 制作者, 制作人
examples: The producers insisted that I add a sex scene to the film.
China is the largest producer and consumer of coal in the world.

defsEn: r. in distinction from others
zh: adv. 特定地, 明确地, 按特性
examples: What specifically do you need me to do?
How did you specifically choose this spot here, in the middle of nowhere?

defsEn: n. a message informing of danger
n. notification of something, usually in advance
zh: n. 警告, 预告, 预兆, 通知
examples: She paid no heed to our warnings.
The warnings are clear and concrete.
exampleZh: 她不把我们的警告放在心上。

defsEn: n. either side of the body below the waist and above the thigh
n. the ball-and-socket joint between the head of the femur and the acetabulum
n. (architecture) the exterior angle formed by the junction of a sloping side and a sloping end of a roof
n. the fruit of a rose plant
zh: n. 臀部, 蔷薇果, 忧郁
a. 熟悉内情的
vt. 使忧郁, 给(屋顶)造屋脊
interj. 喝彩声
examples: This hip-hop artist wears a grill.
Tom had a hip replacement surgery.

defsEn: n the excess of revenues over outlays in a given period of time (including depreciation and other non-cash expenses)
n something that remunerates
v earn on some commercial or business transaction
earn as salary or wages
v acquire or deserve by one's efforts or actions
zh: n. 所赚的钱, 工资, 收入
examples: Our earnings are in proportion to our real ability.
Earnings from Nauru's export of phosphate remains an important source of income.

defsEn: n. bulbous herb of southern Europe widely naturalized
bulb breaks up into separate strong-flavored cloves
n. aromatic bulb used as seasoning
zh: n. 大蒜
examples: Garlic is used to improve the taste of food.
Garlic has a strong smell and a strong flavor.

defsEn: a. relating to or befitting athletics or athletes
s. having a sturdy and well proportioned body
zh: a. 运动的
examples: The athletic meeting will be put off.
Athletic boys are very popular with American female students.
exampleZh: 运动会要延期举行。
运动型男生很受美国女学生欢迎。

defsEn: n. a high-speed military or naval airplane designed to destroy enemy aircraft in the air
zh: n. 斗士, 战士, 好战者, 战斗机
examples: The fighter jet was ready for public view.
That fighter plane dropped a bomb.

defsEn: n. the civilization of Muslims collectively which is governed by the Muslim religion
n. the monotheistic religious system of Muslims founded in Arabia in the 7th century and based on the teachings of Muhammad as laid down in the Koran
zh: n. 伊斯兰教
examples: In Islam, the shahada is the testimony of faith.
Islam will show you the right path in life.
exampleZh: 萨哈达在伊斯兰教是信仰的证明。

defsEn: n a person whose occupation is teaching
zh: n. 教员, 讲师
examples: The instructor advised me to get exercise every day.
The instructor advised me to exercise every day.

defsEn: n the contestant you hope to defeat
zh: n. 竞争者
examples: He is a competitor in the Olympic Games.
He's a competitor in the Olympic Games.

defsEn: n. the state of being pregnant
the period from conception to birth when a woman carries a developing fetus in her uterus
zh: n. 怀孕；丰富, 多产；意义深长
examples: Pregnancy will stretch out your belly button.
The pregnancy left her with stretch marks.

defsEn: n. a senior member of the Christian clergy having spiritual and administrative authority
appointed in Christian churches to oversee priests or ministers
considered in some churches to be successors of the twelve Apostles of Christ
n. port wine mulled with oranges and cloves
n. (chess) a piece that can be moved diagonally over unoccupied squares of the same color
zh: n. 主教, (国际象棋中的)象, 热果子酒
examples: The bishop saw them at church.
A bishop can never end up on an opposite-colored square.

defsEn: a. of or relating to the philosophical study of ethics
a. conforming to accepted standards of social or professional behavior
s. adhering to ethical and moral principles
zh: a. 伦理的, 民族的, 民族特有的
examples: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
In ethical terms, a great many people are opposed to gene therapy.
exampleZh: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？

defsEn: n. a reciprocal relation between two or more things
n. a statistical relation between two or more variables such that systematic changes in the value of one variable are accompanied by systematic changes in the other
zh: n. 相互关系, 相关, 关联
examples: Do you think these two facts have some correlation between them?
I'm unable to grasp the correlation between these two things.

defsEn: v overcome, as with emotions or perceptual stimuli
v charge someone with too many tasks
v cover completely or make imperceptible
v overcome by superior force
s so strong as to be irresistible
s very intense
zh: a. 压倒性的, 无法抵抗的
examples: If you find them overwhelming, set them aside!
I know how overwhelming it can all get.

defsEn: n. a message issued in behalf of some product or cause or idea or person or institution
n. act of raising in rank or position
n. encouragement of the progress or growth or acceptance of something
zh: n. 晋级, 创建, 增进
examples: This promotion properly reflects the quality and diligence of your work.
You're being given a promotion and a raise in security access level.

defsEn: n. a tight or amorous embrace
v. fit closely or tightly
zh: n. 紧抱, 拥抱
vt. 紧抱, 坚持, 使沾沾自喜
examples: She hugged her son and put him to bed.
Is it OK if I hug you?
exampleZh: 她拥抱了一下儿子，然后让他上床睡觉。
我能抱你吗？

defsEn: n. to travel for the purpose of discovery
n. a careful systematic search
n. a systematic consideration
zh: n. 探险, 踏勘, 探测
examples: Mary's exploration of new cultures opened her mind to new perspectives.

defsEn: n. an ordered array of the components of an emission or wave
n. a broad range of related objects or values or qualities or ideas or activities
zh: n. 光谱, 范围, 系列
examples: Tom is on the autism spectrum.

defsEn: n skillfulness by virtue of possessing special knowledge
zh: n. 专家意见, 专门技术
examples: Expertise in computer programming is in high demand in many sectors.
He had the expertise I was looking for desperately.

defsEn: n. a person who receives something
zh: a. 领受的, 容易接受的, 感受性强的
n. 领受者, 容纳者, 容器
examples: I was the recipient of a large settlement.
I was the recipient of the package.

defsEn: a. relating to or characteristic of diplomacy
a. using or marked by tact in dealing with sensitive matters or people
zh: a. 外交的, 老练的
examples: Diplomatic dialogue helped put an end to the conflict.
His diplomatic passport entitles him to immunity from criminal prosecution.
exampleZh: 外交谈判帮助结束了冲突。

defsEn: v. make small or insignificant
v. cause to seem less serious
play down
zh: vt. 将...减到最少
vt. 最小化
vi. 最小化
examples: Minimize the program to the tray.
I minimized the document and then maximized it again.

defsEn: a. refined and tasteful in appearance or behavior or style
s. suggesting taste, ease, and wealth
s. displaying effortless beauty and simplicity in movement or execution
zh: a. 优雅的, 端庄的, 高雅的
examples: With an elegant gesture, the waiter poured water from a silver carafe.
What a lovely and elegant lady you are!

defsEn: n. the act of preventing
zh: n. 阻止, 妨碍, 预防
examples: The prevention of forest fires is everyone's responsibility.
Prevention is better than a cure.
exampleZh: 防止山火，人人有责。

defsEn: n. the intended meaning of a communication
zh: n. 意图, 含义, 故意
a. 专心的, 决心的, 热心的
examples: Intent to destroy is a key part of the crime of genocide.
It is not my intent to hurt you in any way.

defsEn: n. a detailed list of all the items in stock
n. (accounting) the value of a firm's current assets including raw materials and work in progress and finished goods
n. making an itemized list of merchandise or supplies on hand
v. make or include in an itemized record or report
zh: n. 详细目录, 存货清单
vt. 列入详细目录, 清点存货
examples: Ziri took inventory of his belongings.

defsEn: n. the property of relative size or extent (whether large or small)
n. relative importance
zh: n. 巨大, 重大, 重要, 大小, 数量, 星等(指星的亮度)
examples: You need to understand the magnitude of the problem.
No one could believe the magnitude of the tragedy.

defsEn: n. the quality of being widely admired or accepted or sought after
zh: n. 名声, 受大众欢迎, 流行
examples: The popularity of a web site depends on its content.
Popularity has nothing to do with it.

defsEn: v. transfer property or ownership
s. not contained in or deriving from the essential nature of something
s. being or from or characteristic of another place or part of the world
zh: n. 外国人, 外侨
a. 外国的, 相异的
examples: There could be aliens on the Internet and no one would know.
The alien organism can still enter the station through the thrusters.

defsEn: n. the act of taking and printing photographs
n. the process of producing images of objects on photosensitive surfaces
n. the occupation of taking and printing photographs or making movies
zh: n. 摄影, 摄影术
examples: Photography takes me back to my childhood.
Photography is a form of time travel.

defsEn: n. a group of persons together in one place
zh: n. 聚集, 集中, 采集
examples: Let us see if we can cancel the gathering.
What he said cast a chill on the gathering.

defsEn: n. the group of languages derived from Latin
n. a novel dealing with idealized events remote from everyday life
v. have a love affair with
v. tell romantic or exaggerated lies
zh: n. 冒险故事, 浪漫史, 传奇文学
vi. 写传奇, 作空想, 虚构
examples: The romance about outer space still lives in a few of us.
His romance was the talk of the town.

defsEn: n. a case for containing a set of articles
n. gear consisting of a set of articles or tools for a specified purpose
n. young of any of various fur-bearing animals
zh: n. 装备, 工具箱, 成套工具
examples: The kites in the sky are green.
Yanni bought this kit at a local auto parts store.

defsEn: r. without missing a year
zh: adv. 一年一次, 每年
examples: Annually we work on our land.
Annually, this is the way it unfolds for us.

defsEn: n. farm consisting of a large tract of land along with facilities needed to raise livestock (especially cattle)
v. manage or run a ranch
zh: n. 大牧场
v. 经营牧场
examples: At the ranch they found two women, a mother and her daughter.
I grew up on a ranch.

defsEn: s. communicated in the form of words
a. of or relating to or formed from words in general
a. of or relating to or formed from a verb
a. relating to or having facility in the use of words
zh: a. 用言辞的, 言语的, 口头的, 逐字的, 动词的
examples: The two got into a verbal altercation on the topic of pineapple on pizza.
In Lojban, verbal tense and aspect are optional.

defsEn: a. of or relating to a coast
a. located on or near or bordering on a coast
zh: a. 海岸的, 沿海的, 沿岸的
examples: Coastal cities will take the brunt of the storm.
A coastal road is to be built here.

defsEn: n. tender, romantic, or nostalgic feeling or emotion
zh: n. 感情, 感伤, 情操, 情绪, 感想, 意见
examples: You have the same sentiments as the maid.
A lot of Kabyles share the same sentiment.

defsEn: v. perceive intuitively or through some inexplicable perceptive powers
v. search by divining, as if with a rod
s. emanating from God
s. being or having the nature of a god
'tis God-like to create"-J.G.Saxe
zh: a. 神的, 神圣的, 非凡的
n. 神学家
examples: The Quran is a divine revelation.
Divine is the clarity of your eyes, which are diaphanous like crystal drops.

defsEn: n. arousal of the mind to special unusual activity or creativity
n. a product of your creative thinking and work
n. a sudden intuition as part of solving a problem
zh: n. 灵感, 鼓舞人心的人或物, 妙计, 吸气
examples: It gave me the inspiration for this new book of mine.
I was your inspiration for this sentence, and you know it.

defsEn: n. the act of searching for something
v. make a search (for)
v. search the trail of (game)
v. seek alms, as for religious purposes
zh: n. 探索, 寻求, 调查
v. 寻找, 找, 追寻猎物
examples: The quest for knowledge fuels our curiosity and understanding.
The quest for love unites us all.

defsEn: n. an attempt to get something
n. a formal proposal to buy at a specified price
n. (bridge) the number of tricks a bridge player is willing to contract to make
v. ask for or request earnestly
zh: n. 出价
v. 命令, 吩咐, 请求, 表示, 宣布, 投标
examples: I bid you greetings and may there be peace through fellowship between us.
Ziri bid on a rare painting at the auction.
exampleZh: 我向你们致以问候，愿我们之间的友谊带来和平。

defsEn: n. a blow from a flat object (as an open hand)
v. hit with something flat, like a paddle or the open hand
zh: n. 掴, 掌击, 侮辱, 拍击声
v. 拍击, 惩罚
adv. 正面地, 直接地, 突然地
examples: She gave him a slap in the face.
She slapped me on the chin.
exampleZh: 她打了他一巴掌。
她打了我的下巴。

defsEn: a. of or relating to or caused by a toxin or poison
zh: a. 有毒的, 中毒的
examples: Toxic people drag other people down to their level.
Toxic people like to spread their misery around.

defsEn: n. intense sorrow caused by loss of a loved one (especially by death)
n. something that causes great unhappiness
zh: n. 伤心, 忧愁, 悲痛, 不幸, 灾难
examples: Grief on the face is better than the stain in the heart.
Grief can mess you up if you're not careful.

defsEn: n. the person who plays that position on a football team
n. (American football) a position on the line of scrimmage
n. (American football) grasping an opposing player with the intention of stopping by throwing to the ground
v. seize and throw down an opponent player, who usually carries the ball
zh: n. 工具, 复滑车, 滑车, 装备, 扭倒
vt. 固定, 处理, 抓住
vi. 扭倒
examples: That tackle box looks a lot like mine.
He tackled a guy with a gun.

defsEn: n. the quality of being worthy of esteem or respect
n. formality in bearing and appearance
n. high office or rank or station
zh: n. 尊严, 高贵
examples: Giving up your dignity is like trading a horse for a donkey.
Sami lost his dignity and self-respect.

defsEn: r. in a tight or constricted manner
r. securely fixed or fastened
zh: adv. 紧紧地, 坚固地
examples: I tightly grip her hand and close my eyes.
We held on tightly to the branch.

defsEn: n. state of uncertainty or perplexity especially as requiring a choice between equally unfavorable options
zh: n. 困境, (进退两难的)窘境
examples: It was a dilemma for me.
Bruno had a dilemma on who to give the rifle to.

defsEn: n. the state of being legally obliged and responsible
n. the quality of being something that holds you back
zh: n. 责任, 债务, 倾向
examples: The company did not admit liability.
I don't want to take on another liability.

defsEn: r. in an exhaustive manner
r. completely and absolutely (`good' is sometimes used informally for `thoroughly')
zh: adv. 彻底地, 绝对地, 透彻地, 详尽地, 周到地, 完全地, 完善地, 全面地
examples: They got thoroughly wet in the rain.
I thoroughly regretted staying up so late, come morning.
exampleZh: 他们在雨中被淋得全身都湿了。
早上，我十分后悔昨天熬夜到那么晚。

defsEn: n. small slender-bodied chiefly marine decapod crustaceans with a long tail and single pair of pincers
many species are edible
v. fish for shrimp
zh: n. 虾, 小虾, 矮子
vi. 捕小虾
examples: The shrimp that falls asleep is carried away by the current.
The shrimp that falls asleep is swept away by the current.

defsEn: n. the attire worn in a play or at a fancy dress ball
n. unusual or period attire not characteristic of or appropriate to the time and place
n. the prevalent fashion of dress (including accessories and hair style as well as garments)
n. the attire characteristic of a country or a time or a social class
zh: n. 装束, 服装
examples: That costume is too tight for me.
This costume is too tight for me.

defsEn: v. to draw back the lips and reveal the teeth, in a smile, grimace, or snarl
zh: n. 露齿笑
v. 露齿而笑
examples: He said it with a grin on his face.
We grind our coffee by hand.

defsEn: n. a humorous or satirical drawing published in a newspaper or magazine
n. a film made by photographing a series of cartoon drawings to give the illusion of movement when projected in rapid sequence
v. draw cartoons of
zh: n. 卡通画, 漫画
v. 画漫画
examples: The Jetsons, a cartoon about family life in the future, influenced my childhood.
Under the cartoon, he wrote "Get your hot dogs!"

defsEn: n. (economics) the ratio of the quantity and quality of units produced to the labor per unit of time
zh: n. 生产力
examples: Productivity will increase with the expansion of the factory.
My productivity was at its peak yesterday.

defsEn: n. general term for any insect or similar creeping or crawling invertebrate
n. a fault or defect in a computer program, system, or machine
n. a small hidden microphone
for listening secretly
zh: n. 错误, 虫, 病菌, 缺陷, 窃听器, 癖好, 防盗报警器, 双座小汽车, 要人
vt. 装防盗报警器, 装窃听器, 激怒
vi. 捉虫, 暴突
examples: It's not a bug. It's an undocumented feature.
It's not a bug, it's an undocumented feature.
exampleZh: 这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。
这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。

defsEn: n. a state of complete lack of some abstract property
n. inability to discharge all your debts as they come due
n. a legal process intended to insure equality among the creditors of a corporation declared to be insolvent
zh: n. 破产者
examples: Bankruptcy is to the employer what dismissal is to the employee.
The spectre of bankruptcy has loomed over Tom's firm for some time.

defsEn: n. anything that tends to arouse
n. an additional payment (or other remuneration) to employees as a means of increasing output
zh: n. 奖金, 红利
examples: The bonus travelog film is packaged in a splendid digital versatile disc.
The bonus material was actually bogus.

defsEn: n. act of working jointly
n. act of cooperating traitorously with an enemy that is occupying your country
zh: n. 合作, 勾结
examples: Your collaboration is important for all of us.
The collaboration between two leading universities yielded significant results.

defsEn: n. a detachment used for security or reconnaissance
n. the activity of going around or through an area at regular intervals for security purposes
n. a group that goes through a region at regular intervals for the purpose of security
v. maintain the security of by carrying out a patrol
zh: n. 巡逻, 巡逻员, 侦察队
v. 巡逻, 巡视
examples: He did the patrol at two in the morning.
The patrol cars cover the whole of the area.

defsEn: n. an enlightening or astonishing disclosure
n. communication of knowledge to man by a divine or supernatural agency
n. the last book of the New Testament
contains visionary descriptions of heaven and of conflicts between good and evil and of the end of the world
attributed to Saint John the Apostle
zh: n. 揭露, 泄露, 发觉, 默示, 启示
examples: It was a revelation to me.
Revelation is necessarily out of the question with respect to those books.

defsEn: v. draw slowly or heavily
v. transport in a vehicle
zh: n. 用力拖拉, 拖运, 强拉, 捕获量, 拖运距离
vi. 拖, 拉, 改变方向, 改变主意
vt. 拖拉, 拖运
examples: The thieves made off with quite a haul.
They hauled everything in large bags.

defsEn: v. admit (to a wrongdoing)
v. be willing to concede
v. give over
surrender or relinquish to the physical control of another
v. acknowledge defeat
zh: vt. 承认, 退让
vi. 让步
examples: I concede the point, but not the argument.
We concede your right to this property.

defsEn: n. a lavishly produced performance
s. characteristic of spectacles or drama
zh: a. 公开展示的, 惊人的, 壮观的
n. 奇观, 惊人之举, 展览物
examples: She made a spectacular improvement to her Berber level.
His spectacular victory against Tom catapulted John to the top of all the rankings.

defsEn: v. cause to sheer
r. straight up or down without a break
r. directly
zh: a. 绝对的, 全然的, 纯粹的, 透明的, 峻峭的
vi. 偏转, 偏航
vt. 使急转向, 使偏航
adv. 完全, 全然, 峻峭
n. 偏航
examples: It is a sheer waste of time.
It would be sheer madness to do that.
exampleZh: 这完全是浪费时间。

defsEn: n. a person who is immune to a particular infection
a. relating to the condition of immunity
s. secure against
s. relating to or conferring immunity (to disease or infection)
zh: a. 免疫的, 免除的, 不受影响的
n. 免疫者
examples: Everybody is immune to smallpox nowadays.
You're not immune to the virus.
exampleZh: 现今每个人都对天花免疫了。

defsEn: n. a pompous fool
n. hardy and sure-footed animal smaller and with longer ears than the horse
zh: n. 驴, 傻瓜, 笨蛋, 屁股
examples: Your ass is so fat you can't hit the hole in the toilet bowl.
They made an ass out of me.

defsEn: r side by side
zh: adv. 在旁边, 靠拢着
prep. 在...旁边, 与...在一起
examples: Alongside the zoo is a botanical garden centre.
He came alongside at precisely the right moment.

defsEn: v cause to be interested or curious
v to render motionless, as with a fixed stare or by arousing terror or awe
v attract
cause to be enamored
s capable of arousing and holding the attention
s capturing interest as if by a spell
zh: a. 迷人的, 吸引人的, 使人神魂颠倒的
examples: What a fascinating job you have!
It was a fascinating story, and he told it well.

defsEn: s. strikingly strange or unusual
zh: a. 异国的, 外来的
n. 外来人, 外来物, 舶来品
examples: Her exotic perfume has a subtle scent.
Mary was an exotic Middle Eastern beauty.

defsEn: n. any of various small fasteners used to hold loose articles together
n. an article of jewelry that can be clipped onto a hat or dress
n. the act of clipping or snipping
n. a sharp slanting blow
zh: n. 修剪, 夹子, 回形针, 剪下来的东西
vt. 修剪, 痛打, 夹牢, 剪报
vi. 剪报
examples: Could you clip my ticket please?
I clipped some articles out of the newspaper.

defsEn: n. the part of the leg between the hip and the knee
zh: n. 大腿, 股
examples: Your thighs must feel it when you ride.
She has a tattoo of a lizard on her thigh.

defsEn: n. a film or TV program presenting the facts about a person or event
a. relating to or consisting of or derived from documents
zh: n. 记录片
a. 文件的
examples: That documentary about the environmental crisis was a real eye-opener.
There's a documentary on today that I absolutely want to see.
exampleZh: 这部有关环境危机的纪录片真是令人大开眼界。

defsEn: n. someone injured or killed or captured or missing in a military engagement
n. someone injured or killed in an accident
n. a decrease of military personnel or equipment
zh: n. 意外事故, 伤亡, 受害者
examples: There were no casualties, and the hospital was moved to temporary accommodation.
Tom is in the casualty department.

defsEn: n. putting a condemned person to death
